calculation.description: At date t, fade each instrument's seven-session return relative to the cross-sectional median, volatility-scaled by its trailing 20-session daily-return standard deviation. Activate the signal only when the lagged observation-only VIX is above its trailing 60-session median. All inputs are lagged or trailing and therefore available before the next-session return. The VIX is a macro observation signal and is not tradable.

validation.regime_notes: Positive daily IC in each reported regime: 2020-2022 0.06728, 2023-2024 0.01602, and 2025-2026 0.02722. The signal is active only in approximately 43.64% of dates, so the 765-date conditional sample is smaller than the full history. Small 15-instrument universe warrants conservative uncertainty.
